_comment: Local-compose variant of mimoto-issuers-config.json — same shape, localhost/compose-network URLs. Browser-facing URLs (redirect_uri, token_endpoint) use host-mapped localhost ports; URLs Mimoto fetches server-side (proxy_token_endpoint, credential_issuer_host, wellknown_endpoint) use compose service names. token_endpoint goes through Inji Web's own nginx proxy so it stays same-origin for the browser. authorization_audience is the aud Mimoto writes into its client assertion, and must match what the local eSignet advertises (MOSIP_ESIGNET_DOMAIN_URL=http://localhost:58088).
